description: Run tests through the connected project's official Unity Test Framework and wait for the structured result. Use this instead of unity_execute reflection or invoking NUnit methods directly. It supports NUnit lifecycle, UnityTest coroutines, Edit Mode, Play Mode, skips, parameterized cases, and domain reload recovery. After writing or hot-reloading C# tests, call unity_recompile before running; the new test tree becomes runnable after compilation and domain reload complete. The tool is present only when Unity Test tools are enabled for the workspace and com.unity.test-framework is installed. All parameters are optional. Omit assemblies, tests, groups, and categories when that filter is unused; do not send empty arrays.

mode.description: Optional Unity Test mode to run. Use edit|play to run both modes in one request; defaults to edit|play. Play Mode runs still start from Edit Mode and Unity Test Framework controls the transition.

groups.description: Optional Unity Test Framework group-name regular expressions.

timeout_ms.description: Host-side timeout in milliseconds for sync execution, clamped to 1000..3600000. Background async/notify execution has no time limit.

result_detail.description: Result detail returned to the agent. failures includes failure messages and stack traces; all includes every leaf result.
